parts.label: For New Foreign Buildings:—
row_labels: (a) For every building not exceeding 20,000 cubic feet
(b) For every additional 5,000 cubic feet or fraction thereof
(c) For alterations on plans already approved, not involving any addition to the cubical extent thereof
(d) For alterations to existing buildings within the existing external walls (fee otherwise to be charged in accordance with (a) and (b))

(e) If the plan should show a series of buildings of the same style, the fee will be computed for the first house according to the above rules, and for each other house half the rates will be charged.

parts.label: For New Chinese Buildings:—
row_labels: 4 houses or under with outhouses belonging thereto

parts.label: For Water Closet Installations:—
row_labels: (a) For not more than three basins

footnotes: Note.—For the purpose of computing the above fees a Chinese house shall be taken as having a superficial ground area, exclusive of yard space, not exceeding 400 square feet. (printed under 'For New Chinese Buildings')
